$description: Antseed assets. Made by AstraOS for Antseed, v1, 12 Nov 2026. The source of every painting, film, pose, logo, font, icon and tool in the kit: the page's gallery, the tables in DESIGN.md and the two zips are built from it (build.mjs). Every URL is relative to /brand/ (../assets/… is the live site's own file; ../hero/#… is where the site uses it). Filenames stay the site's own; the subject lives in the record.

fields.id: Stable name. PROMPTS.md anchors the recipe that made it by the same id (PROMPTS.md#v01).
fields.kind: painting | film | object | pose | sprite | logo | font | icon | licence | tool | capture | template | not-this
fields.group: scene | vignette | board | object | archetype | reaction | pose | rig | lockup | mark | pixel | maker | …
fields.subject: What it shows, in plain words.
fields.aspect, w, h: Nominal aspect and real pixel size, read from the file (both sides of a pair are the same size).
fields.status: live (on the site, use it) | spare (finished, not placed) | in-progress (do not extrapolate) | retired (never use; reason says why).
fields.reason: One line: why it has this status.
fields.day, night: The day file and the night file made by editing it. A night URL only exists when the night is a painting or a baked sprite.
fields.file, files: For things that are not a day/night pair (fonts, logos, icons, tools, films), and extra files that go with a record.
fields.folder: A whole folder, when the record stands for a set.
fields.quiet_area: Where text and windows can go on it.
fields.prompt: The PROMPTS.md anchor of its recipe; null with recipe: "unknown" when nobody recorded it.
fields.alt: Alt text to use with it.
fields.pack: Where the zips put it: kit/<folder> in antseed-brand-kit.zip, any other path in antseed-paintings-and-mascot.zip; null: not packed.
fields.refs: Stable names under refs/ in the kit zip, for the images to attach to prompts: { side: name }.
fields.archetype, pose, legs, eyes, night_mode: Mascot records: who it is, the pose, how many legs (two is the rule; a few older sprites are documented exceptions), eyes (lost-look, or exception when the moment needs other eyes), and how it looks at night (css-filter: the night character filter in tokens.css; baked: its own night file).
fields.archive: Files that are not shipped, sent on request.
fields.built_from, slots: Templates (kind template): the tokens, asset IDs, components and site lines it is built from, and the URL parameters it takes (templates/README.md). The whole templates/ folder goes into the kit zip, so a template's pack is null; files holds its 960 px previews.
fields.product: X posts: the one product a template is for. Never put another product's lines, terminal or capture in it.
fields.rights: Generated images (paintings, poses, films, objects): their rights are pending; LICENSES.md says why.
